### About our network
MatHost serves hosting customers and gaming communities, providing VPS, dedicated servers, colocation, DDoS-protected IP transit and tunnels.

### Customer BGP & own prefixes
Customers can announce their own IP prefixes through BGP sessions on VPS, dedicated servers and GRE or WireGuard tunnels. Sessions are managed through our customer panel, with automatic ASN ownership verification and support for customer AS-SETs.

Customer BGP sessions are available at no additional session charge with an active eligible service.

### Remote connectivity & DDoS protection
Our GRE and WireGuard tunnels extend DDoS-protected connectivity to infrastructure hosted outside our network, with BGP support for customer routing.

Network overview: https://mathost.eu/en/network/

Tunnel services: https://mathost.eu/en/tunnels/
